scripts.build: npm run build -w functions && npm run build -w web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w functions && npm run typecheck -w web
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
scripts.test:unit: npm run build -w functions && node --test tests/validators.test.mjs && npm run test -w web
scripts.test:functions: npm run build -w functions && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-broadcast-functions --only firestore "node --test tests/functions.test.mjs"
scripts.test:integration: npm run build -w functions && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-broadcast-tests --only firestore "node --test tests/rules.test.mjs tests/functions.test.mjs"
